pages.text: The controller checks these rules every tick. If one fails, nothing happens at all, so build carefully.$(br2)$(l)Outputs$()

$(li)The first output sits $(item)directly on top$() of the controller. Then pipe, output, pipe, output, up to $(item)six outputs$().$(li)The stack stops at the first block that breaks the pattern, so a missing pipe hides every output above it.
$(li)The number of outputs must $(item)exactly$() equal the number of products of a recipe. That is how you choose the recipe: add or remove an output to switch.

$(l)Tank size$()$(li)The tank must be at least $(item)twice as tall$() as the number of outputs: 6 outputs need 12 blocks of tank.$(li)With $(item)more than 3 outputs$(), the tank must be at least $(item)2 blocks wide$(). Steel tanks go up to 3 x 3.

$(l)Placement$()$(br)The controller faces away from the tank: place it while looking at the tank wall. It must touch the tank, or it cannot stay in place.$(br2)Goggles on the controller show the $(item)Heat Level$(), the $(item)Output Count$(), and $(item)Steel Fluid Tank Not Found$() when the tank is missing.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
